questions.question: What best describes RestTemplate?
options: A synchronous client that calls other HTTP services
A tool that builds database tables from records
A non-blocking server for streaming events
A template engine that renders HTML pages
questions.explanation: RestTemplate sends HTTP requests to other services and waits for the reply, converting the body to Java objects.

questions.question: Which RestTemplate method returns the status code and headers along with the body?
questions.explanation: getForEntity returns a ResponseEntity, so you can read the status and headers as well as the body.

questions.question: The supplier reports flour at Rs 42 per kg. What does /bakery/cost?item=flour&kg=10 return in the BakeHouse code?
questions.explanation: The controller multiplies the kilograms by the per kilo price, so 10 times 42 is 420.

questions.question: The supplier answers 404 for saffron. In the endpoint that has no try/catch, what status does the bakery's own caller receive?
questions.explanation: The HttpClientErrorException is not caught, so it travels up and Spring Boot replies 500.

questions.question: A developer calls getForObject(url, List.class) and expects Doctor objects, but gets maps instead. What is the fix?
options: Add the @Autowired annotation to the list
Use exchange with a ParameterizedTypeReference of List<Doctor>
Set the read timeout to zero
questions.explanation: Generics are erased at runtime, so a type reference is needed to tell Jackson the item type is Doctor.
